DrvEye — vendored third-party engine
=====================================

This directory is a vendored snapshot of the DrvEye static-analysis engine,
committed as plain files inside portable-driver-triage (not a submodule), so a
`git clone` of this repo builds without extra steps and the Docker image can
COPY it directly.

Upstream provenance (do not lose this):

    source:  https://github.com/0xDbgMan/DrvEye.git
    commit:  8f538197101de21d0ceb2d6e14af9a2828235a2b
    short:   8f53819
    date:    2026-04-27 19:23:55 +0300

To refresh against upstream: re-clone that commit (or a newer one), copy the
tree over this directory, update the fields above, and re-run the Docker build
healthcheck.
